name: Zuken Inc.
summary: Zuken Inc., a software company, research and development, manufacturing, and sales of solutions related to printed circuit board (PCB) designs, electrical panel and cabinet design, engineering data management, and wire harness designs in Japan, Europe, the United States, and rest of Asia.
